about.title: Who Am I?
content: I'm a software developer and UI designer with a passion for building intuitive digital experiences. My journey into tech began with a mathematics degree, where I studied C/C++ and Java, which I've since complemented through self-directed learning in Python and web technologies. I stay current with industry developments by regularly engaging with technical documentation and building side projects.

I pursued a Master's degree in Information Security at Amirkabir University of Technology, where I developed deep expertise in security protocols and best practices—knowledge that has become integral to my development approach. While I didn't complete the program, the experience fundamentally shaped how I think about secure, resilient software architecture.
